name: @familyhub/e2e
description: End-to-end tests (Playwright + playwright-bdd). Self-contained so the browser tooling installs here, not at the repo root. Unit + integration + perf stay at the root.

scripts._assert-bddgen: find .features-gen -name '*.spec.js' | grep -q . || (echo '✗ bddgen produced 0 specs — feature/step paths broken?' && exit 1)
scripts._assert-bddgen-critical: find .features-gen-critical -name '*.spec.js' | grep -q . || (echo '✗ bddgen produced 0 specs — feature/step paths broken or @critical tag missing?' && exit 1)
scripts.test:e2e: bddgen test --config playwright.config.ts && pnpm run _assert-bddgen && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:critical: bddgen test --config playwright.critical.config.ts && pnpm run _assert-bddgen-critical && playwright test --config playwright.critical.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ui: bddgen test --config playwright.config.ts && pnpm run _assert-bddgen && playwright test --ui --config playwright.config.ts
